inputs.text: Wake up, it is all a scripted theater run by the hidden puppet masters. Look at the public admission: "The split happens as certain MPs bring up the possibility of a fresh discussion regarding the party's leadership." This manufactured clash between Angus Taylor and Andrew Hastie over increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors is just a controlled opposition strategy to keep us distracted and divided from the real agenda. And do not miss the obedience test with their global controllers, where "the opposition leader did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump while declining to state whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran." They are completely beholden to external masters, and the real narrative is hiding right there in what they refuse to say.
